title: The Mollie Payments for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 8.2.0 does not verify a product's publication status…
description: The Mollie Payments for WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions prior to 8.2.0 have a vulnerability where the plugin does not verify whether a product is published before allowing an order to be created via its PayPal express-checkout endpoint. This flaw enables unauthenticated users to place orders for draft or unpublished products.
